localizationPairs: Nebius uses dated continuing operations and a separate ownership-claims model. The displayed default is a slow-transition funding stress, not management guidance or an economically validated fair-value estimate.
Nebius采用对应日期的持续经营业务与独立的权益索偿模型。显示的默认值是缓慢转型及融资压力情景，并非管理层指引或经过经济验证的公允价值估计。

Convertible fair value replaces its carrying amount once; converted shares are not also counted. Parent RSUs and prefunded warrants are included once. Eigen participating shares are already in the reported common-share count.
可转债公允价值仅替换一次账面价值，不再重复计入转换后的股份。母公司RSU和预付认股权证仅计入一次；Eigen参与分红股份已包含在已披露普通股数量中。

Avride employee awards use a $100m analyst reserve, not a reported fair value. Test $0m, $500m and $1,000m; these are scenarios, not a proven upper bound. Avride awards are never added to Nebius shares.
Avride员工奖励采用分析假设的1亿美元扣减，并非已披露公允价值。应测试零、5亿及10亿美元情景；这些情景不构成已证实的上限。Avride奖励不会加入Nebius股数。

The Avride reserve changes value by at most $0.39 per annual-base share or $0.34 per June-base share for each $100m, before option allocation. A zero equity floor does not prove the uncertainty immaterial.
每增加1亿美元Avride扣减，在期权分配前，每股价值最多下降0.39美元（年度基准）或0.34美元（六月基准）。股权价值归零并不证明该不确定性不重要。

Parent options use a Black-Scholes scenario with 60% volatility and a 4.2% risk-free rate anchored to the annual grant assumptions. Contractual life is used conservatively; June life is carried forward and the weighted strike aggregates different awards.
母公司期权采用Black-Scholes情景，波动率60%、无风险利率4.2%，参考年度授予假设。保守地使用合同期限；六月期限从年度结转，且加权行权价汇总了不同奖励。

Negative FCFF already includes the modeled reinvestment outflow. Do not deduct the same funding need twice. The calculation assumes funding is available on fair terms; distress, financing fees and issuance below fair value can reduce existing-shareholder value further.
负自由现金流已包含模型中的再投资流出，不应重复扣减同一融资需求。计算假设可以按公允条件获得融资；财务困境、融资费用及低于公允价值发行股份可能进一步降低原股东价值。
The dated cash and ownership bridge excludes later financing. Customer prepayments are not free revenue: the model must also fund delivery of the prepaid services.
现金与权益分配桥梁以基准日期为准，不计入后续融资。客户预付款并非免费收入；模型也必须承担履约服务所需资金。

A staged-margin illustration reaches -15%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 22% and then 25% EBIT margin. These are analyst assumptions; revenue growth, reinvestment and discount rate stay unchanged so the effect of the faster profit transition is visible.
分阶段利润率示例将营业利润率设为-15%、5%、12%、18%、22%，之后为25%。这些是分析假设；收入增长、再投资和折现率保持不变，以显示加快盈利转型的影响。

The 2026 revenue guidance midpoint implies about 504% growth from the 2025 annual base, above the engine’s 200% per-year limit. It is disclosed as a reference rather than silently capped or substituted into the default.
2026年收入指引中值相对2025年度基准意味着约504%的增长，超过引擎每年200%的上限。因此仅列为参考，不会暗中截断或替换默认假设。
